description: FootballGPT helps football coaches use their saved coaching setup (age group, format, club type, formation, experience, qualifications, priorities and squad shape) to get coaching advice, build structured training sessions, search a practice library, and create saved animated practices. Player names, ages, shirt numbers and notes never leave FootballGPT through this app. Coaches remain responsible for reviewing and adapting every recommendation for their players.
